comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/selection-through-bodies.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1956): a block 40 x 40 x 20 mm centred on the origin (F1.b0, z from -10 to 10) and Sketch1 (F2) on the XZ plane through it with a 20 x 38 rectangle from x -10 to 10 and z -8 to 30 (the XZ frame's y is -Z): the lower part of its profile lies inside the block, the upper part above it, where a click with no command active selects it (one of its two triangles' middles is there).
